== Usage ==
Input value -> a (default 50)<br>
Max value -> b (default 100)<br>
Filled square color -> y (default #ff5)<br>
Half-filled square color -> z (default #dd0)<br>
Other parameters include advStyle (default empty), height (default 6) and stretch (default 35).<br>
  <nowiki>{{PVm|a|b|y|z}}</nowiki>
